amendments.change: Two reported-only additions, both fixed before the screen table was assembled: (1) sub-column W7_strict = the intervention-only W7 (None where Tier B did not run) printed beside the registered W7 slot, whose prereg rule lets W7c carry rows without an intervention pass - so a reader can see the effect of that fallback on W7's pre-screen rho; (2) src/cluster_sensitivity.py, a LINEAGE-cluster bootstrap (resample the 7 independent lineages, keep all arms of a drawn lineage) reported beside the registered checkpoint bootstrap, because the 48-row screen panel contains only 7 independent lineages (3 in-house families carry 12-14 near-duplicate arms each). Registered decisions continue to use the checkpoint bootstrap and the point estimate exactly as frozen.
amendments.impact: reporting only; the registered pre-screen threshold, statistic and panel are unchanged
amendments.reason: n=48 must not be mistaken for 48 independent observations, and a mixed W7 column must be visible as such
amendments.section: reported additions (no rule change, no selection input)
